assumptions.choice: BUY signal is generated when Fast SMA (20) crosses above Slow SMA (50) (bt.ind.CrossOver > 0).
assumptions.reason: The spec defines the Technical Trading Rule (TTR) as an SMA crossover, which canonically refers to the bullish crossover event.

assumptions.choice: ROC metrics evaluation classifies each day t as TP/FP/TN/FN using close(t) > open(t) on the bar the BUY signal is generated.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly defines TRUE BUY and FALSE BUY using the condition close(t) > open(t) for the day t when the BUY signal is generated.

assumptions.choice: Buy order enters at Market Open on bar t+1 and closes at Market Close on bar t+1 using exectype=bt.Order.Close.
assumptions.reason: In daily-bar Backtrader without lookahead bias, orders submitted on signal bar t execute at Open of bar t+1 and exit at Close of bar t+1 to model single-day non-overnight holding.
